commit.message:
mirror: bootstrap flash-driver + view/input pipeline work

Syncs the parallel RE session (the work that was still private):

- analysis/ghidra-scripts/probe35-69 + mem_scan{2}.py + FindDspiUsers.py
  (view system, input pipeline, memory scan, bootstrap MMIO/flash/disasm).
  Probes only - the raw decompiler output they produce stays private.
- docs/flash-driver.md   SPI NOR upgrade path decoded from the bootstrap:
  DSPI 0xfc05c000, multi-vendor JEDEC RDID probe, erase 256 KB / program
  512 B, staged in DDR at 0x3FF80008, layout bootstrap+FPGA 0x0-0x7FFFF and
  MAIN OS 0x80000+. The opcode-level helpers sit behind absolute pointers
  that do not point at those instructions in the file, so the real driver is
  runtime-loaded - a replacement OS uses standard JEDEC commands instead.
- docs/usb-reflash.md    plan + stages to make the custom OS own USB (receive
  to RAM, validate, write only the MAIN OS section, reboot), keeping the
  FUNC+power DIN path as the invariant that never breaks.
- README/STATUS updated with the flash/upgrade-path findings + pointers.

Sanitization: leak-scanned (no binaries, no hex dumps). Paraphrased two more
quoted device strings on the way out (the downgrade-refusal and upgrade-state
messages). "OS UPGRADE" is kept in the recovery instructions - it names the
menu entry a user has to select, so genericising it would break them.
